# Elias Sorel

> Independent researcher publishing open preprints (French, with English abstracts) on the living world, matter and the cosmos. Every work has a DOI on Zenodo and an HTML page with its English abstract on this site. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

Author: Elias Sorel · ORCID 0009-0003-7980-9944 · https://eliassorel.com/

Method: each paper starts from published, cited work and proposes a reading; claims are labelled (established, debated, hypothesis, reading, calculation).

## Works

- [L'Équation du soi : voyage à travers l'individu (Libre arbitre · Déséquilibre · Soi) · The Equation of the Self: a journey through the individual (Free Will · Imbalance · Self)](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/l-equation-du-soi/): The self posed as an equation to be tested in chemistry, physics and mathematics (a bath of 29 molecules, efference copy, Kuramoto phase agreement); 11 proposed tests, 218 references. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23858442
- [Le Diamant : ce qui vibre, se souvient, éclaire (Vibration · Mémoire · Lumière) · The Diamond: what vibrates, remembers, illuminates (Vibration · Memory · Light)](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/le-diamant/): Le Diamant (The Diamond) follows one question across three levels: are rest, conservation and perception what they appear to be? I · Vibration (thesis): nothing is at rest. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22730664
- [L'Icosaèdre : ce qui s'étage, se lit, résonne (Échelle · Perception · Résonance) · The Icosahedron: what layers, is read, resonates (Scale · Perception · Resonance)](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/l-icosaedre/): This text starts from a question: from which scale do we look at the living world? It holds in one sentence, "life is a recommencement at different scales", and measures it in three parts. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23250209
- [Metaphysical Stones](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/metaphysical-stones/): Metaphysical Stones is a collection of fifty-four aphorisms ("stones") that state, to the bone, a single view of reality: the world is better described as movement and relation than as fixed, isolated objects. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22865098
- [Le Big Bang : l'éclat qui aveugle · The Big Bang: the blinding glare](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/le-big-bang/): Observational limits and the inference of a cosmological origin. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22938295
- [Le poulpe : le corps distribué · The octopus: the distributed body](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/le-poulpe/): Anatomy and physiology of a body without a centre. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22676077
- [La crevette-mante : l'œil qui cherche l'accord (Poing · Œil · Accord) · The mantis shrimp: the eye that seeks attunement (Fist · Eye · Attunement)](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/la-crevette-mante/): Cavitation strike and polarization vision in stomatopods; an eye that rolls on itself acts as a rotating analyser, read as a search for attunement rather than a fine image; 9 testable questions, 78 references. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23891659
- [La mitochondrie, la complexité comme dette plutôt que comme conquête · The mitochondrion: complexity as debt rather than conquest](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/la-mitochondrie/): The mitochondrial origin of eukaryotic life. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22918398
- [Le tardigrade : la survie par le retrait · The tardigrade: survival by withdrawal](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/le-tardigrade/): Cryptobiosis and morphological stasis, read as a displacement of selective pressure. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22920277
- [Le blob : l'accord sans chef · The blob: agreement without a leader](https://eliassorel.com/papiers/le-blob/): Physarum polycephalum: information processing with no one inside. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22870113

## Other pages

- [Chimère](https://eliassorel.com/chimere/): the site's AI; it reads the ten works above and answers with cited sources and DOIs (in preparation).
- [Constellation](https://eliassorel.com/constellation/): map of how the works connect.
- [Lexicon](https://eliassorel.com/lexique/): the corpus vocabulary (French).
